Has anyone given ZS Associates DAA interview?

This round was conducted by a company employee and lasted about an hour. It began with a brief self-introduction followed by a few questions based on my background.

The main part of the interview was a business case study. I was given a scenario involving a company's performance and had to analyze the information provided, interpret data, identify possible causes of business issues, and recommend solutions. The discussion tested both quantitative and qualitative thinking.

The interviewer expected me to:

Analyze charts, tables, and metrics.
Draw logical conclusions from the data.
Justify my recommendations with clear reasoning.
Compare alternative approaches and explain my choices.

There was also a guesstimate question to evaluate structured thinking, assumptions, and problem-solving approach. The focus was more on the framework and thought process than arriving at an exact number.

The interviewer was friendly and interactive throughout the discussion and frequently asked follow-up questions to understand my reasoning.---plus next round is behavioural and managerial interview

• Audio Comprehension and Listening Assessment: Candidates listen to recorded conversations, statements, or short audio passages and are required to interpret the information accurately. Questions may involve answering comprehension-based queries, completing missing information, or providing responses based solely on what is heard in the recording.

• English Language and Verbal Skills: This section measures proficiency in English through exercises on vocabulary, sentence improvement, grammatical accuracy, contextual word meaning, error identification, and reading comprehension. The emphasis is on understanding language usage and applying grammar rules effectively.

• Communication Effectiveness and Spoken Response: In certain assessment stages, candidates may be asked to record verbal responses or participate in timed speaking tasks. These activities evaluate the ability to express ideas clearly, communicate confidently, maintain logical flow, and deliver responses effectively within the allotted time.
